text:
Ava M.: incident-bot just flagged a sustained increase in model-serving tail latency for region-us-west starting ~09:02. It's currently at ~12% of requests > 1.2s instead of usual <1%. Not yet customer-facing alerts but noise is high. tagging oncall: @Rohit @Maya.

oncall-bot: [INCIDENT] alert: model-serving-tail-latency-high triggered (region-us-west) — severity: P2 — id: INC-20260109-2223 — runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/model-tail-latency

Rohit: I'm on it. grabbing logs and current autoscale activity. please post any customer signals if you see them.

Maya: I saw a couple retries from qps spikes, but no 500s in the last 15min. adding to this: grafana panel for tail latency shows correlated increase in KV cache eviction rate.

Jordan: pinging infra team to check eviction config & GPU memory pressure: @Liam any infra clues?

Liam: looking. nodes show little GPU mem pressure, CPU ok. KV cache eviction spiked because we hit a few long-context requests — likely eval jobs. throttling candidates: 1) throttle long-context evals, 2) increase cache size for serving pool, 3) temporary routing to cold pool (higher latency) to defuse tail.

Maya: good list. For immediate mitigation I'd prefer routing evals away and toggle an autoscale burst to add an extra 2 serving pods. Can we do quick canary routing?

Rohit: initiating routing change: `rb route set --match "tag:eval" --dest cold-pool-us-west --ttl 10m` — applying now.

oncall-bot: deploy-bot started change r-7893 by Rohit — routing policy update in progress.

Ava M.: handoff note: I'll take postmortem and alert tuning follow-up. @Natalia will you own dashboard and rule changes?

Natalia: I can do dashboards. First pass: lower noise by adjusting alert rule to fire only when p95 > 900ms AND p99 > 1.2s for 5m, plus require a minimum request volume to avoid noisy spikes. Proposed new rule snippet: ```expr: (histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(latency_bucket[5m])) by (le, region)) > 1.2) and (sum(rate(requests_total[5m])) by (region) > 50)``` will add to PR.

Maya: also add labeling to distinguish "eval" traffic vs "prod" so we can route/alert separately. I noticed we didn't have that label on a few legacy eval jobs.

Jordan: good call. For paging policy: this was P2 and paged. Given the impact was internal and we mitigated within 8 minutes, recommendation: split alert severity — P1 pages only if error rate or customer-facing latency breach; P2 should create a ticket and notify channel but not page unless multiple regions affected or sustained >15m.

Rohit: agree. I'll open a RFC for the severity mapping change: "page on customer-facing SLO breach or >=3 regions affected OR sustained >15m". For other infra-only signals we convert to P2/ticket.

Ava M.: action items: 
- Rohit: RFC for paging/severity mapping (due EOD)
- Natalia: dashboard + graph panel + PR for alert rule change (due tomorrow 11:00)
- Maya: add eval label to legacy jobs + small rollout (due EOD)
- Jordan: update runbook with routing play and postmortem link (due tomorrow)

Liam: follow-up from infra: cold-pool routing applied, autoscale +2 pods triggered and tail now back to baseline. No customer 5xxs.

oncall-bot: INC-20260109-2223 status: mitigated (routing + autoscale) — please ack and close when ready.

Ava M.: acknowledging mitigated. I'll keep this thread for handoff notes and please post postmortem draft when ready. tagging SRE to review severity RFC: @ops-sre.

Natalia: creating a new dashboard (dash-1187) and a Grafana snippet in PR: https://git.redwood/dashboards/d/1187/model-tail-latency. I'll include a new panel split by traffic_type (prod/eval).

Maya: quick note on threshold tuning — let's prefer combining quantile and volume checks. Pure p99 triggers on tiny volume are noisy.

Jordan: agreed. Also add an annotation stream for routing changes so we can correlate mitigations in the timeline. Suggest `annotations{source="routing"}`.

Rohit: RFC posted: https://go/redwood/rfc/pager-severity-refactor — high level: page on customer impact only; infra-only -> ticket; built-in exceptions for cascading failures. Please comment.

Ava M.: thanks everyone. I'll schedule a 30min post-incident sync tomorrow to finalize alert policy changes and dashboard review. If anyone sees recurring noise after the rule change, add to the RFC thread. :thumbsup:

Liam: closing note — infra will also add a short-term 5m debounce on eviction alerts to reduce flapping while we fix labeling.

oncall-bot: INC-20260109-2223 closed by Ava M. — incident duration: 00:08:00 — mitigation: route-eval->cold-pool, autoscale +2, eviction debounce.

Ava M.: closing handoff. Postmortem draft: https://go/redwood/postmortems/INC-20260109-2223 (will link in here once ready).
